blockdesc-drive-crank-*: The hand crank that starts the line. Right-click to wind it; the line spins up and coasts down as the wind runs out.
blockdesc-drive-shaft-*: Carries the crank's power along a straight run to the flywheel and the mill.
blockdesc-flywheel-*: Keeps the line turning between winds. It reserves the eight cells around its hub; sneak-click any of them to brake it.
blockdesc-quernstand-*: The stand the mill core sits on. The mill is complete once the core stands on it; Ctrl + Shift + right-click shows what is still missing.
blockdesc-millcore-*: The quern that grinds. Right-click it with a sack of grain to load it; complete, loaded and at speed it grinds grain to flour.
ingameerror-handmill-notgrain: That is not a grain or a grain sack.
